annotations.text:
PC Remote · direction A (dark console)
Flow: Connect → Touchpad. Bottom tabs switch between Pad / Keys / Apps / Screen / Share. Keys tab = the touchpad with the typing field open (not drawn separately).
App tiles use letters as placeholders — real icons come from the PC at runtime.
Screen preview needs new server work: capture at ~12 fps, JPEG, tap-to-click maps preview coords to the monitor.
Clipboard sync is two-way. Files land in a fixed folder on the PC; photos use the Android share sheet too.
